p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

def fast_power(base, exponent, modulus):
    result = 1
    while exponent > 0:
        if exponent & 1:
            result = (result * base) % modulus
        base = (base * base) % modulus
        exponent >>= 1
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(fast_power(p, p - 1, MOD))
elif k == 1:
    print(fast_power(p, p, MOD))
else:
    visited = [False] * (p + 1)
    cycle_length = 1
    current = k
    visited[1] = True
    while not visited[current]:
        visited[current] = True
        current = (current * k) % p
        cycle_length += 1
    total_power = (p - 1) // cycle_length
    print(fast_power(p, total_power, MOD))
